title: React Developer
description:
About This Role
**10 to 15 years of experience**  

**Skills: React, JavaScript , REST APIs , HTML5, CSS3, CI/CD pipelines**

Role: React JS Developer


Experience: Relevant experience in React JS development


Required Skills:


* Strong hands\-on experience in React JS
* Good knowledge of JavaScript (ES6\+)
* Experience working with Redux for state management
* Strong understanding of GraphQL APIs and integration
* Hands\-on experience in Unit Testing frameworks such as Jest/React Testing Library
* Experience in building responsive and reusable UI components
* Understanding of REST APIs and frontend integration
* Knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, and modern UI practices
* Familiarity with Git/version control systems
* Good debugging and problem\-solving skills

Responsibilities:


* Develop and maintain scalable frontend applications using React JS
* Build reusable and optimized components
* Integrate APIs using GraphQL/REST services
* Write unit test cases and ensure code quality
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams for development and deployment
* Participate in code reviews and follow best coding practices
* Troubleshoot and fix frontend issues efficiently

Preferred Skills:


* Exposure to Agile/Scrum methodology
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines
* Knowledge of performance optimization techniques
